title: Viewshed Explorer
description: 360° terrain visibility analysis tool. Drop an observer anywhere on the map, compute a viewshed across a configurable radius (2–150 km), and explore an interactive polar elevation diagram showing the horizon skyline, occluded terrain, island points, and named peaks above 2500 m. Includes earth curvature correction, pan/zoom on the diagram, and a live hover cross-highlight between the map and diagram.
